summary.text: On the metal plane of Mirrodin, whose native Mirrans were left behind when Memnarch fell, a drop of Phyrexian oil carried unknowingly by Karn spreads a corruption that lets Phyrexia rebuild itself using the plane as host.
Koth, Elspeth and Venser try to track the corruption to its source, and the Mirrans unite against the Phyrexian invasion.
Their quest leads to Karn, held prisoner in the core, where Venser gives his spark and heart so that Karn can reignite and vow to stop the Phyrexians.
